column1: Across the parking lot and the vending machine, three defects share the same shape: AvailableState.release() printing 'cant release' and returning normally; AwaitingPaymentState.cancel() printing 'refunding 1.0' while moving no money; and completePurchase() deciding the reserve from a single payment method. What is the common lesson?,Always print more diagnostic messages,"Output that describes an action is not the same as performing it, and a caller that receives a normal return has no way to distinguish a real success from a message about an intention",Never use System.out.println in production code,Always validate input at the start of every method,,2,"The recurring failure is silence-shaped: the code carries on as normal after doing nothing, or after doing something partial. Either throwing, or returning a result the caller must inspect, would have exposed all three.",2
